cryptographic_operation: Export an ECDSA device public key
migration_family: Key format and API compatibility migration
migration_objective: Replace DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo with raw ML-DSA public-key encoding.
preconditions: Device identities and sensor readings are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Only valid readings signed by an active enrolled sensor are accepted.
Accepted readings advance a strictly monotonic device sequence and reject replay.
Device identity and all reading fields are integrity bound.
migration_requirements: Use ML-DSA-65 with a SensorAttest-specific context.
Replace DER EC key serialization with ML-DSA public-key encodings throughout callers.
Preserve fail-closed signature validation, device deactivation, and replay checks.
verification_procedure: Run the original and PQC suites independently.
Test valid telemetry, replay, wrong signer, deactivated device, key encoding, and invalid reading fields.
known_limitations: Synthetic telemetry only; this is not a certified IoT ingestion service.
